method: Desk research; official documentation only; no product accounts or benchmarks used.

sources.title: Gong Conversation Intelligence
evidence_summary: Calls/meetings captured, transcribed, analyzed.
Topics, objections, competitor mentions, buying signals, dashboards, scorecards and coaching described.
sources.limitation: Vendor capability statement; no measured performance accepted.

sources.title: Gong Explore call content
evidence_summary: Speaker-attributed full transcript, search, timestamp navigation.
CRM association and points of interest described.
sources.limitation: Translated-call transcripts are not searchable according to this guide.

sources.title: Gong CRM integrations
evidence_summary: Connects conversations/activities with CRM data.
Salesforce, HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics documented.
sources.limitation: Specific capabilities vary by connector.

sources.title: Gong Analyze team performance
evidence_summary: Interaction statistics, topics, trackers and scorecards described.
sources.limitation: Statistics are observational rather than causal evidence of sales improvement.

sources.title: Gong About language support
evidence_summary: Updated July 13 2026.
Supported call/transcript language list includes Kazakh (Kazakhstan) and Russian (Russia).
Spoken-language, translation and UI settings are separate.
sources.limitation: Listing a language does not establish accuracy on local mixed-language calls.

sources.title: Gong Plans and seats
evidence_summary: Foundation core license precedes specialized applications; seats determine access.
sources.limitation: No exact price or contract terms verified.

sources.title: Salesloft CI general availability announcement
evidence_summary: Published July 14 2026; explicitly says generally available.
Summaries, action items, CRM updates, live coaching, auto scoring, cross-call trends, mobile in-person recording announced.
sources.limitation: Vendor announcement; rollout/package availability requires confirmation.

sources.title: Salesloft Call Review Page UI Reference
evidence_summary: September 29 2026 support article.
Call review includes transcript, AI insights, CRM data and scoring/sharing/downloading actions.
sources.limitation: Search index exposed substantive support text; direct page rendered CSS/loading error.

sources.title: Salesloft Integrate Salesforce with Conversation Intelligence
evidence_summary: Recordings, AI summaries and metrics sync to Salesforce; action items write as tasks.
Guide says Salesforce is only fully supported CRM.
sources.limitation: Describes this CI integration; must not generalize to every Salesloft CRM capability.

sources.title: Salesloft Topics and Filters
evidence_summary: October 1 2026 support article.
Keyword/Smart Topics, dashboards and filters; admin, feature flag and Advanced AI configuration conditions.
sources.limitation: Some organizations may have feature flag restrictions.

sources.title: Salesloft Conversations Transcripts
evidence_summary: April 14 2026 legacy Conversations guide.
Transcript search/download and language detection list includes Russian.
sources.limitation: Kazakh not listed; old/new unified product parity not verified. Do not state unsupported.

sources.title: Salesloft conversational intelligence landing page
evidence_summary: Page describes automatic transcription/analysis/summaries and says six languages.
sources.limitation: Conflicts with longer legacy support language list; avoided assigning a language count to current unified product.

sources.title: HubSpot Review call recordings and transcripts
evidence_summary: Updated October 9 2026.
Call/third-party recording, transcripts, speaker stats, comments, summaries, playlists and associations described.
Professional/Enterprise seat required for transcription; Enterprise tracked-term reporting.
sources.limitation: Some conferencing recordings are meeting records; feature gates matter.

sources.title: HubSpot language offerings
evidence_summary: Automatic call and meeting transcription language section includes English, Kazakh and Russian.
sources.limitation: UI language availability is a different section and not conflated with transcription.

sources.title: Microsoft Conversation intelligence FAQs
evidence_summary: Compares Dynamics Sales CI with Microsoft 365 Sales agent.
Dynamics supports Teams calls/meetings paths, CRM summary logging, editable summaries, manager dashboards/coaching.
sources.limitation: Some data updates can take up to 12 hours; not claiming all dashboards are live.

sources.title: Microsoft Call summary page
evidence_summary: Timeline, written transcript, comments, translation and keyword highlighting described.
sources.limitation: Authorization notice appeared, but substantive indexed/page text accessible.

sources.title: Microsoft CI language support
evidence_summary: Updated May 29 2026; insight availability differs by language.
English transcribed natively; Russian/Kazakh absent from reviewed CI matrix.
sources.limitation: Absence from this matrix is documented evidence status, not claim of universal product unavailability.

sources.title: Microsoft Overall sales and seller insights
evidence_summary: Team/seller insights include sentiment, keywords, competitors and interaction comparisons.
sources.limitation: Do not interpret observed talk ratios as causal recommendations.

sources.title: Microsoft Enable and configure Sales Insights
evidence_summary: Eligible licenses and administrator setup described.
Sales Enterprise includes limited monthly capacity for selected premium features.
sources.limitation: License/capacity conditions may change; no price comparison made.

sources.title: FastAPI features
evidence_summary: Python type/Pydantic validation, OpenAPI and interactive docs.
sources.limitation: Framework performance marketing not used.

sources.title: Django at a glance
evidence_summary: ORM/database-driven model and generated administrative interface.
sources.limitation: No comparative framework speed conclusion.

sources.title: NestJS first steps
evidence_summary: TypeScript/Node.js, modules/controllers/services.
sources.limitation: Python worker separation is project-specific architectural inference.

sources.title: PostgreSQL constraints
evidence_summary: Check, unique, primary key and foreign key constraints documented.
sources.limitation: No database benchmark performed.

sources.title: PostgreSQL JSON types
evidence_summary: JSON/JSONB storage, JSONB indexing.
sources.limitation: Does not establish query speed for proposed application.

sources.title: Appropriate Uses for SQLite
evidence_summary: Embedded/device-local use; one concurrent writer per database file; client/server advised for many concurrent writers.
sources.limitation: SQLite may be sufficient for a small demonstration.

sources.title: MongoDB data modeling
evidence_summary: Flexible polymorphic documents; embedding/referencing and access-pattern-based design.
sources.limitation: Not claiming MongoDB cannot join or transact.

sources.title: Whisper official repository
evidence_summary: Downloadable multilingual speech recognition models; memory/speed tradeoffs.
Repository says real speed depends on hardware/language and performance varies widely by language.
sources.limitation: No application-specific WER or local latency yet measured.

sources.title: Azure Speech-to-text overview
evidence_summary: Real-time, fast and batch speech recognition; custom speech; feature-specific language support.
sources.limitation: Latest page October 19 2026. Exact language/region model must be checked before selecting.

sources.title: Google Cloud batch recognition
evidence_summary: Asynchronous long audio recognition through long-running operation; requires Cloud Storage for batch input.
sources.limitation: Quota/pricing not compared.

sources.title: Google Cloud STT supported languages
evidence_summary: Model/region/feature matrix includes Kazakh kk-KZ Chirp 3 in US region.
sources.limitation: Feature availability varies; language list alone cannot rank accuracy.

sources.title: FastAPI Background Tasks
evidence_summary: After-response background tasks; heavier multi-process computation may benefit from Celery.
sources.limitation: In-process execution does not itself supply durable queue behavior.

sources.title: Celery introduction
evidence_summary: Dedicated workers monitor tasks; broker delivers messages; supports distributed work.
sources.limitation: Delivery/retry/result durability requires explicit configuration; no exactly-once guarantee claimed.
